title: Provider-neutral AWQ evidence submission and AWG batched oracle bridge

binding.worktree_digest: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
binding.identifiers: AR-, EVID-, BATCH-, DISC-, DEC-, GUID-, and SES- opaque identifiers

evidence_submission.rule: A reference identifies evidence for AWQ; it is not evidence acceptance.

oracle_batch.discussion: runtime_request with requested status and digest-only bounded context
oracle_batch.decision_guidance: awg_external with received status and digest-only payload
oracle_batch.rule: Only AWG may author decisions or reusable guidance; the runtime preserves supplied envelopes and does not manufacture them.

projection.rule: The projection contains references and externally attributed observations only; it never claims AWQ acceptance or an AWG decision.

privacy.allowed: opaque identifiers, enumerations, bounded integers, revisions, and SHA-256 digests only

failure_semantics.side_effects: The model and checker perform no AWQ, AWG, Coordinator, provider, network, process, UI, LLM, Git, or durable-state operation.

limitations: A passing check proves only structural consistency of supplied references and envelopes.
A digest does not prove evidence truth, AWQ acceptance, AWG admission, decision, or guidance validity.
Transport and authoritative submission remain future integrations owned by AWQ and AWG.
